# AccelFury

> AccelFury develops reusable hardware IP and development tools for specialized compute, starting with FPGA.

Component logic is separated from target-specific integration. Portability is assessed for each component, version and target; additional targets are a development direction.

## Products and information

- [IP components](https://accelfury.com/ip-cores/): component contracts, access and scoped verification. af-pdm-rx receives raw PDM; it does not convert PDM to PCM or provide CIC/FIR processing.
- [af](https://accelfury.com/products/af/): IP development toolchain; consult the product record for current status, access and workflow limitations.
- [Developers](https://accelfury.com/developers/): evaluation and integration path.
- [Enterprise](https://accelfury.com/enterprise/): scoped engineering and licensing discussions.
- [Machine-readable product records](https://accelfury.com/data/products.json): canonical lifecycle, availability and evidence fields.

## Interpretation

- A public product page does not imply public source or a downloadable package.
- Keep lifecycle, access and verification separate. Reported results are not independently reviewed passes.
- Missing reports mean unknown results; do not infer failure or that checks were never run.
- Do not infer all-vendor portability, board qualification, production readiness or available ASIC products.
- Read each component's license; the website license does not license the IP.

Contact: [mail@accelfury.com](mailto:mail@accelfury.com). Start with a non-confidential summary.
